questTitle: Run a Half Marathon on my 39th bday
statusStatement: Another interval-training session is reported completed toward the half marathon. Completion of this week's long run and two-run target is not established.
desiredOutcome: Run a half marathon on 20 November 2026, my 39th birthday, while re-establishing a sustainable running baseline through two consistent runs per week: one long run and one interval run.
